nodes.label: Fork Base-Repository Warning
nodes.rationale: GitHub points new PRs at the UPSTREAM repo by default, so personalized-fork work (own profile data, local portals, another AI runtime) accidentally lands upstream. The template warns to check the base-repository dropdown; fork adaptations belong in forks and are discovered via the pinned Community forks discussion (#78).

nodes.label: PR Verification Section
nodes.rationale: Asks contributors to state what they ran (lint_skills.py, check_framework_version.py, bun test / typecheck, unittest discover) so reviewers do not have to re-derive the verification steps from CONTRIBUTING.md.
